verdict.line: You lose if you let Camille's empowered Q autos poke you down while she resets with Hookshot; you win if you force stand-and-trade fights that stack Hemorrhage to 5 before she can disengage.

brief.thesis: Darius wins this lane on the numbers (51.7% over 172 games, solo-kill edge) because Hemorrhage stacking gives him a true-damage execute that Camille's Adaptive Defenses shield can't block, and her only real escape tool is a wall-dependent leap. The lane is decided by whether Darius forces committed trades before Camille can reset space with Q's bonus Move Speed or reach a wall for Hookshot.

theirWindow.what: Camille can freely land Q (Precision Protocol) empowered autos and W (Tactical Sweep) poke without fearing your execute threat, so don't extend trades yet — just farm and land Q's blade edge to build stacks.

yourWindow.when: Camille sits at 3-5 Hemorrhage stacks in range
yourWindow.what: Pull her in with E (Apprehend, 535 range) and finish with R (Noxian Guillotine) — the true damage scales per stack and the kill refreshes its cooldown, so you can chain it if allies are also low.

start.why: Highest-performing start at 51.2% over 162 games — the AD and sustain let you win early trades and shrug off Camille's Q-empowered auto pokes while you stack Hemorrhage.

boots.why: 80.5% pick rate and best winrate (50.3%) — the flat damage reduction blunts every auto in Camille's kit, since her whole trade pattern (Q, W outer edge, R bonus autos) is physical or auto-attack based.

core.why: The active haste closes the gap Camille tries to open with Hookshot's Move Speed and lets you stick through her Q recast window.
Built-up Move Speed on the charge means you're never out of Apprehend range when she tries to walk up for a Q auto.
Highest-winrate finished path at 63.6% over 22 games — the damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through her burst while your own Hemorrhage bleeds tick away.

situational.when: she's building lifesteal or burst and your all-ins are getting traded back
her Ultimatum's bonus magic damage on autos is adding up faster than your physical trades
the enemy team stacks hard CC beyond just Camille's kit

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror ramps through prolonged combat, which is exactly the stand-and-trade pattern you need to stack Hemorrhage to 5 before committing Guillotine — master-tier players instead run Stormraider's Surge (Sorcery), which suits a more hit-and-run poke style that punishes Camille's Q recast window and resets rather than fully committing to extended fights.

summoners.why: Flash+Ghost is both the most-picked (59.7%) and highest-winrate (51.7%) combo — Ghost closes distance on a champion whose whole kit is built around disengaging via Hookshot. Flash+Ignite (46.9%, 31.8% pick) is the alternative if you want to guarantee the Hemorrhage-execute kill before she can juke it.

playing.title: Stack passive before all-in
playing.detail: Hemorrhage stacks up to 5 and enrages Darius at max stacks; land autos and Q hits on Camille first so Guillotine's true damage is fully scaled when you commit.

playing.title: Hit Q's blade, not the handle
playing.detail: Decimate's outer swing (the blade) deals more damage than the inner handle — land the edge of the circle on Camille specifically, not just the aoe center.

playing.title: Punish the empowered Q auto
playing.detail: Precision Protocol is a next-attack windup with an optional recast; the moment you see that empowered auto land, close with W (Crippling Strike) to slow her before the bonus Move Speed lets her reset space.

playing.title: Deny Hookshot with your own E
playing.detail: Apprehend's pull (535 range) can catch Camille before she reaches a wall for Hookshot (800 range) — hooking her early sends her engage/disengage tool to a 16-12s cooldown before it ever lands.

playing.title: Respect the delayed W cone
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep fires after a delay and its outer half slows and heals her — walk through or past the telegraph rather than backing straight through the outer edge.

playing.title: Max Q, then E, not W
playing.detail: The data's skill order maxes Q first for trade damage, E second — prioritizing E gets Apprehend's cooldown down to 16s sooner for repeat interrupts on her engages.

playing.title: Her ultimate doesn't stun you
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum anchors you to the area near her rather than rooting or stunning — you can still trade, use E, or land Guillotine if you're already stacked when it lands.

brief.patchCaveat: All build, rune, summoner, and winrate figures come from measured Darius-vs-Camille games on the current patch (172-game sample for the head-to-head); the ability interactions and timing reads connecting them to Camille's kit are my own tactical analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Try to hit Camille at the edge of [Q] when dealing damage. Maintain your passive stacks and fight her whenever she steps in range and interrupt her (E) with your [E].
